summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Dynamic Web Portfolio powered by Supabase. Covers all 5 phases: Next.js 14 scaffolding, Supabase client setup, database migrations (8 tables, RLS, triggers, seed data), public pages (Home, About, Projects, Contact), admin dashboard with full CRUD for Projects/Skills/Certifications/Achievements, auth middleware, analytics, SEO, responsive design, and documentation. Includes file-level details for every component grouped by feature area.
